criteria.text: A member can book a free room slot in the room's local time and is charged credits per started half hour.
Cancelling more than 24 hours before the start refunds in full; later cancellations refund nothing.
A retried request with the same request id books and charges at most once.
Every balance change is recorded exactly once, and the balance equals the sum of its records.
Two bookings of the same room never overlap, even partly, under simultaneous requests from several processes.
A member's balance never goes below zero under simultaneous bookings.
Simultaneous cancellations of the same booking refund at most once.

owner_answers.answer: No buffer between bookings: one may end at 10:00 and the next start at 10:00.
Store times in UTC together with the room's time zone; show them in the room's local time.
